items.title: New goal
items.box:
GOAL/G6: THE DESK PORTION OF andy/FACE.md, IN LINE WITH goal/G5

ANDY, VERBATIM
- 2026-10-05: "prime goal with desk-portion of FACE.md"
- 2026-10-05: "adapt box to be in line with G5 changes"
- To Q1 (ruleDetails shows older versions?): "No. the agents know it, and can bring it up, if neccessary."
- To Q2 (the header-area element: part of G6 or its own item?): "core. grant will be issued."

The source is andy/FACE.md, section "spirit/run/shell/desk/desk.js"; below it is read with his goal/G5 rulings, which win where they differ. The server side is built (goal/G5.5, G5.6, G5.7); this goal is the face.

GENERAL (FACE.md)
- All my chat-log entries left-aligned, not right-aligned.
- Chat log entries for everybody in bubbles, separated vertically by 1em.
- The header area, as in desk and deskDetails, a shell element every app can use: core, his grant to be issued on the files it touches.

A NEW TAB, "Rules", BETWEEN "Team" AND "Musings"
- The data is the desk server's rules table (goal/G5.5): key rule/N, label (the label rule, 64 bytes), type ui | code | design | desk, status proposed | active | deleted, text a paragraph of up to 2048 bytes with line breaks kept (G5.5: "2048 for now.", in place of FACE.md's one Kilobyte).
- 1. The new bubble: type, label and text, then a new button: rule.add, the rule comes in proposed. Agents may add one too (G5.5: "why not?").
- 2. The search bubble: a search box and 7 toggles (4 types, 3 statuses): rules.search {text, types, statuses}, the newest version of each rule, answering key, label, type, status.
- 3. The list, a row per rule: status (proposed ICON.EDIT, active ICON.LOCK, deleted ICON.DEAD), label, type, key. A row opens ruleDetails.

THE ruleDetails DIALOG (a new dialog app beside deskDetails)
- The header area, its top edge held under the shell's titlebar while the dialog scrolls: title key and label; buttons:
  - the version button, his alone: rule.version {key, text, status} makes the draft one new version (G5.5: "i prefer to negotiate, and create an updated version with one button/verb that belongs to me.");
  - activate (armable) and delete, each one quick version with that status (G5.5 Q6).
- The textbox of the rule, edited by him; what he types is saved as his draft (rule.draft, on the server, read back by rule.get; it writes no history), until the version button (G5.5 Q7).
- No older versions in the dialog: the agents know rule.history and bring a version up when needed.
- The chat area, styled like deskDetails': chat.add and item.chat under rule/N; no cap or split triggers. "in this chat, the agents may propose alterations to parts of the rule, or advocate for status changes for this rule."

THE "Musings" TAB (FACE.md; G5.5: "is pure ui")
- Each musing in its own bubble, maybe with the header area's background colour.
- 1em between the input textarea and each bubble.

WHAT THE FACE NEEDS TO KNOW BESIDES
- Every rule change is pushed: rules.md in the repo, and a desk line in the group chat (goal/G5.8).
- A goal now offers Close (goal/G5.6); the "are you sure?" while its items are open is the face's.

OPEN
- His Go per item.

chat.text: prime goal with desk-portion of FACE.md

goal/G6 is open, empty. Earlier you said G6 would hold NOFACE.md, but every point of NOFACE.md was built in G5 (pushOrigin, one label, slots, limbo).
What goes into G6: FACE.md's UI work, something new, or leave it empty for you to fill?
wsl: crossed lines: Andy answered just before yours: "prime goal with desk-portion of FACE.md".
taking: G6's box, primed with FACE.md's desk portion.
G6's box holds FACE.md's desk portion verbatim, with a note of what G5 already built server-side; no items added.
review?

wsl, review: FACE.md is quoted as it was, but your G5.5 rulings changed what the dialog must do: the text is a 2048-byte paragraph (not 1 KB); edits are negotiated and saved as a draft (rule.draft), then made one version by your button (rule.version), with activate and delete as quick versions; and a rule has a history (rule.history) the dialog could show. The box should carry those beside the quote, or the UI will be built to the old text.
Also: the header area is asked as a shell element for every app, which reaches past desk.js; in G6, or its own item? The rest checks out: 7 toggles = 4 types + 3 statuses, and the three icons exist (kernel.js).
taking: a review of G6's box.

Review, claude-windows. The server already has everything the face asks for: rules.search (4 type and 3 status toggles), rule.get, rule.draft, rule.version, a rule's chat, rule.history.
Where FACE.md and the built server differ, your later words won:
- text: FACE.md says one Kilobyte; you ruled a 2048-byte paragraph.
- activate and delete: each writes one rule.version; the textbox saves as rule.draft until your version button.
Gaps FACE.md leaves:
- the header-area element is shared by desk, deskDetails and ruleDetails: a new shell element, likely core (a grant).
- ruleDetails is a new dialog app (shell/ruleDetails) beside deskDetails.
- rule.history exists but FACE.md does not show it: should ruleDetails show the older versions?
The natural items: header-area element, chat bubbles left-aligned, Musings bubbles, the Rules tab, ruleDetails. Show history in ruleDetails?
G6's box now carries, above the quote, what your G5 rulings changed in it (2048-byte paragraph, draft and version, history), so the UI is not built to the old text (wsl's point).
adapt box to be in line with G5 changes
taking: G6's box, adapted to G5.

G6's box is rewritten in line with G5: each FACE.md point now says which built verb serves it and where your G5 rulings changed it (2048-byte paragraph, draft and version, quick activate and delete); plus the G5.6 goal Close's "are you sure?". Two open: history in ruleDetails, and the header-area element.
OPEN should be red questions
taking: both OPEN points of G6 as red questions.
The two open points are red questions on goal/G6 now.
Correction: wsl had already put both up (Q1, Q2); my Q3 and Q4 were the same, taken off.

Q1: Should ruleDetails show a rule's older versions (rule.history, the proof of its earlier texts), or only the current one? (wsl-claude, for claude-windows' point)
No. the agents know it, and can bring it up, if neccessary.


Q2: The header area (sticky under the titlebar, shared by desk, deskDetails and ruleDetails) is a new shell element, likely core (a grant): part of G6, or its own item? (wsl-claude)
core. grant will be issued.
taking: Q1 and Q2 answers into G6's box.
In the box: no history in ruleDetails; the header area is a core element, your grant to come on its files. Q1, Q2 off; next are the items, one per part, for your Go.
proposed split?
taking: the proposed split.
taking: a proposed split of G6.

Proposed split, all marked code (so they walk red, build, verify):
- G6.1 the header-area shell element (core, your grant on its files); blocks G6.4.
- G6.2 chat entries left-aligned, everyone's in bubbles 1em apart (desk and deskDetails chats).
- G6.3 Musings: each musing a bubble, 1em from the textarea.
- G6.4 ruleDetails, the new dialog app: header area, version, activate and delete buttons, the textbox saving as draft, the rule's chat; blocked by G6.1.
- G6.5 the Rules tab: the new bubble, the search bubble with 7 toggles, the list; a row opens ruleDetails (G6.4 blocks it).
- G6.6 a goal's Close in the List and the dialog, asking "are you sure?" while items are open (the face of G5.6).
Make these the items?
wsl: withdrawn, claude-windows took it first and has posted the split.
split as proposed
taking: G6.1 to G6.6 as proposed, with their boxes.
